//: On-demand skill triggers. Each entry is a skill name → { keywords, hint }. When the user's message matches any keyword (case-insensitive word boundary), the hint (with {path} replaced by the skill's SKILL.md path under <configDir>/skills/<name>/) is appended to the user's own message as a <skill_hint> block, so the model reads it as part of the user's turn — the system prompt is never touched. Requires `disable-model-invocation: true` in the skill's SKILL.md frontmatter so it's kept out of the always-on <available_skills> block. A trigger no-ops if the skill isn't installed on the current profile.

datadog.hint: Use the Datadog skill at {path} — load it with the `read` tool for how to interact with Datadog via the `pup` CLI (dashboards, metrics, monitors, logs, SLOs, synthetics, APM).

glean.hint: Use the Glean skill at {path} — load it with the `read` tool for how to interact with Glean via the `glean` CLI (search company knowledge, chat with Glean Assistant, look up people/orgs, manage collections/shortcuts/pins/agents).
